newsitem.title: USA: USTR's Barshefsky - can't assess fast-track votes.
newsitem.headline: USTR's Barshefsky - can't assess fast-track votes.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky said Tuesday that she could not yet assess the number of Democrat votes in support of fast-track trade authority.
She was asked about House Speaker Newt Gingrich's comment that President Clinton would need to bring 90 Democrat votes to support fast-track for it to move in the House.

"I don't want to make any comments on possible vote counts. I don't think either the administration or the members of Congress are in any particular position to count votes at this point," Barshefsky told reporters after a hearing.
